prompt_summary: Pixel-art Old Factory side-scroller route floor and platform sheet for a cat action game: riveted gunmetal floor plates, rusted steel beams, amber hazard stripes, soot, worn bolts, cyan factory rim lights, and three distinct horizontal floor/platform strips on a flat magenta chroma-key background.
post_processing: Generated on magenta chroma key, alpha-matted with local remove_chroma_key.py, cropped into one repeatable 256x96 floor tile plus two 320x96 transparent platform sprites, then imported through Godot 4.7.
